Industrial automation that keeps the line running

Unplanned downtime costs a mid-size plant an average of eleven working days a year. Northwind control systems are built to remove the causes of those days one at a time, starting with the ones your maintenance team already knows about.

Request a demo

Recommended for you: because you viewed the retrofit programme, here are three case studies from automotive plants.

  • Audi Ingolstadt
  • BMW Regensburg
  • Ford Valencia

Built for plants that cannot stop

Retrofit without a shutdown

Controllers are commissioned line by line while the rest of the plant keeps producing, so a full modernisation never needs a single plant-wide outage window.

One parts catalogue for twenty years

Every controller shipped since 2006 is still supported from stock, and the interface between generations is guaranteed for the life of the installed base.

Compliance evidence, not compliance paperwork

Batch records, calibration logs and audit trails are produced by the same system that runs the process, so the evidence pack for an inspection is generated rather than assembled.

Northwind Industrial Systems designs, builds and services control equipment for continuous-process plants in forty-one countries, and has done since 1948.
